verdict.rationale: Aircall's developer docs include a guide to creating a webhook and listening to Aircall events (aircall-docs-3) and a separate guide to tracking SMS activity with messaging webhooks (aircall-docs-11), so both call and message events reach developer-owned endpoints. The evidence is limited to tutorial titles, with no detail on the event catalog or delivery semantics. Missing for 10: explicit list of call event types, details on payload, retries, and signature verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
